artworks.title: Polydectes Turned Into Stone by Perseus
artworks.description: Pogány's Seriphos climax — Perseus unveiling Medusa at Polydectes' feast, the tyrant and his friends turned to stone.

artworks.title: King Polydectes Petrified by the Head of Medusa
artworks.description: Leclerc's engraving — King Polydectes petrified, the return that frees Danae and Dictys.

artworks.title: Perseus Promises Polydectes to Kill Medusa
artworks.description: The promise that starts the quest — Perseus before Polydectes, the boast that sends him after Medusa and brings him home a founder.

popCulture.title: Perseus
popCulture.description: After the Gorgon and Andromeda — Polydectes petrified, Acrisius' oracle fulfilled, Mycenae founded: the hero's nostos as dynasty.

popCulture.title: Mycenae
popCulture.description: The citadel Perseus founded — myth's origin story for the house that would later host Agamemnon.
